KB-billing-billing-variant-3-v1.title: Billing issues (variant 3): recurring tickets
KB-billing-billing-variant-3-v1.what_we_see: Ticket summaries contain only templated category wording ('User reported billing while using X') with no symptom detail. A significant issue is that product mismatches are present in the summaries (e.g., 'User reported billing while using CloudSync' when the product is actually InsightHub). In this cluster, 242 out of 300 tickets display a summary-product mismatch, as exemplified by ticket 'TKT-00046'.
